integrity: Finite gap lemma with a six-factor exhaustive cyclic-position certificate; checker and output included. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The strict order-sixteen lower bound is 4097; the exact optimum is unproved. The only tested dyadic orders are 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16. Historical priority beyond examined sources is uncertain.
title: First dyadic failure of density-tight circular attractors for Lyndon de Bruijn cycles
